definition: Fire (merged) identifier within its year.
calculation: NFP mergid; for 2021 re-assigned by point-in-polygon against the final perimeters (stale ids).
caveats: mergids restart every year - use fire_key. Final merged id: fires that merge later share an id before they merge.

definition: Pixel centre, EPSG:3571 northing.
calculation: As delivered; 2021 reprojected from lon/lat.

definition: Pixel centre, EPSG:3571 (equal-area, polar) easting.
calculation: As delivered; 2021 reprojected from lon/lat.

definition: VIIRS along-scan pixel size.
calculation: As delivered.
caveats: Grows towards the swath edge (0.36-0.8 km): a scan-angle proxy.

definition: VIIRS along-track pixel size.
calculation: As delivered.
caveats: Scan-angle proxy.

definition: Fire radiative power of the detection.
calculation: As delivered (VIIRS I-band active-fire product).
caveats: Radiant power only (~10-20 % of heat release). Attenuated by smoke/pyroCu around onset.

definition: Satellite (all SNPP in this atlas).
calculation: As delivered.
caveats: Constant - no information.

definition: Real detection time of the pixel.
calculation: As delivered.

definition: 12 h overpass group name, YYYYMMDD + AM/PM.
calculation: From the NFP file name.
caveats: AM/PM are local-solar groups (~02:00 / ~13:00).

definition: Fire id was re-assigned by geometry (2021 only).
calculation: Point-in-polygon vs final perimeters, then nearest perimeter within 1 km.
caveats: QC flag - not a feature.

definition: Unique pixel identifier.
calculation: year * 1e8 + running index after sorting the year's detections by time, x, y.

definition: Globally unique fire id.
calculation: year * 1e7 + mergid.
caveats: Use as the grouping key in cross-validation.

definition: Global step index (all steps 2013-2023 in one sorted series).
calculation: Position in the sorted step list.

definition: Longitude of the pixel centre.
calculation: Inverse of the EPSG:3571 projection.
caveats: Do not use as a model feature (inventory coverage differs by region).

definition: Latitude of the pixel centre.
calculation: Inverse of the EPSG:3571 projection.
caveats: Do not use as a model feature.

definition: Alaska / Canada / Eurasia from lon/lat.
calculation: Longitude/latitude boxes.
caveats: For stratified evaluation only - never a feature.

definition: Calendar year of detection.
calculation: From datetime_utc.
caveats: Evaluation grouping only.

definition: Day of year.
calculation: From datetime_utc.
caveats: Season proxy; removed from predictors earlier by decision.

definition: 1 = pixel of the pyroCb's credited fire within LABEL_MAX_DT_H (12 h) of onset and LABEL_MAX_DIST_KM (10 km) of the corrected centroid.
calculation: labels.label_pixels from pcb_events (matched events).
caveats: Outcome - never a feature. Cutoffs are settings; see sensitivity report.

definition: Excluded from both classes: near a pyroCb but outside the label cutoffs.
calculation: Credited fire's bracket pixels outside cutoffs, other fires' pixels in the pooled radius.
caveats: Never treat as negative.

definition: pyroCb event id(s) of labelled pixels (';'-joined).
calculation: From the inventory.
caveats: Grouping key for event-level weights.

definition: Inside the region/years where negatives are trusted (NEGATIVE_DOMAIN).
calculation: True everywhere unless NEGATIVE_DOMAIN is set.

definition: Pixel footprint area.
calculation: DS * DT.
caveats: Covariate for scan angle; larger edge pixels are less sensitive.

definition: Other VIIRS detections within 1.5 km.
calculation: KD-tree count over this and the previous overpass, all fires, excluding the pixel itself.
caveats: Includes detections from later in the same overpass window; sensor-coverage dependent.

definition: Summed FRP of other detections within 1.5 km.
calculation: As nb_n_*, summing frp.
caveats: Smoke attenuation lowers it for exactly the intense cases.

definition: Other VIIRS detections within 5 km.
calculation: KD-tree count over this and the previous overpass, all fires, excluding the pixel itself.
caveats: Includes detections from later in the same overpass window; sensor-coverage dependent.

definition: Summed FRP of other detections within 5 km.
calculation: As nb_n_*, summing frp.
caveats: Smoke attenuation lowers it for exactly the intense cases.

definition: Elongation of the surrounding detections: 1 = round blob, >>1 = line/front.
calculation: sqrt(l1/l2) of the covariance of neighbour positions within 5 km (this + previous overpass); NaN with < 3 neighbours.
caveats: Capped at 100.

definition: Share of the 1.5 km disc already burned earlier this season.
calculation: Sum of footprints (DS*DT) of detections within 1.5 km that are > 1 h earlier (any fire, same year) / disc area, capped at 1.
caveats: Corrects the land-cover map, which is last year's. Counts only detections seen by VIIRS.

definition: Predecessor pixel: nearest earlier detection of the same fire.
calculation: KD-tree on (x, y, fire) among detections 1-48 h earlier and <= 30 km away; -1 = none (new lobe).
caveats: Link for the *_dpath change columns.

definition: Distance to the predecessor pixel.
calculation: Euclidean in EPSG:3571.
caveats: NaN without predecessor.

definition: Time between predecessor and this detection.
calculation: Difference of real detection times.
caveats: QC.

definition: Local spread rate.
calculation: spread_dist_km / spread_dt_h.
caveats: Biased by overpass spacing (12 h) and pixel size; a lower bound on fast runs.

definition: Unit spread vector, grid-x component.
calculation: (pixel - predecessor) / distance in EPSG:3571.
caveats: Grid frame, not true east; rotate with vectors.true_to_grid before combining with geographic vectors.

definition: Unit spread vector, grid-y component.
calculation: As spread_ux.
caveats: Grid frame.

definition: Is the ground 1.5 km ahead along the spread direction already burned this season?
calculation: 1 if any earlier detection lies within 375 m of the point d km ahead of the pixel along (spread_ux, spread_uy), else 0.
caveats: NaN without spread vector. 0 can also mean 'unburned and not yet detected'.

definition: Is the ground 3 km ahead along the spread direction already burned this season?
calculation: 1 if any earlier detection lies within 375 m of the point d km ahead of the pixel along (spread_ux, spread_uy), else 0.
caveats: NaN without spread vector. 0 can also mean 'unburned and not yet detected'.

definition: Elevation.
calculation: Mean of the 90 m DEM over a 200 m-radius disc around the pixel.
caveats: DEM is a surface model (includes canopy).

definition: Slope.
calculation: arctan of the DEM gradient (true metres per degree at each latitude), averaged over the 200 m disc.
caveats: 90 m cells smooth steep terrain.

definition: Eastness of the downslope direction.
calculation: sin(downslope bearing, clockwise from true north) at the pixel's cell.
caveats: Undefined (noise) on flat ground; use with slope.

definition: Northness of the downslope direction.
calculation: cos(downslope bearing) at the pixel's cell.
caveats: As aspect_sin.

definition: Terrain position: pixel elevation minus the mean elevation within the disc (> 0 ridge/peak, < 0 valley), radius 1.5 km.
calculation: NaN-aware FFT disc convolution of the 90 m DEM in true metres.
caveats: Needs >= 25 % land in the disc (coast / lakes give NaN).

definition: Terrain position: pixel elevation minus the mean elevation within the disc (> 0 ridge/peak, < 0 valley), radius 5 km.
calculation: NaN-aware FFT disc convolution of the 90 m DEM in true metres.
caveats: Needs >= 25 % land in the disc (coast / lakes give NaN).

definition: Terrain roughness: standard deviation of elevation within the disc, radius 1.5 km.
calculation: NaN-aware FFT disc convolution of the 90 m DEM in true metres.
caveats: Needs >= 25 % land in the disc (coast / lakes give NaN).

definition: Terrain roughness: standard deviation of elevation within the disc, radius 5 km.
calculation: NaN-aware FFT disc convolution of the 90 m DEM in true metres.
caveats: Needs >= 25 % land in the disc (coast / lakes give NaN).

definition: Terrain slope in the direction the fire is moving: > 0 running upslope, < 0 downslope.
calculation: DEM gradient (true-frame, rotated into the EPSG:3571 grid frame) dotted with the unit spread vector.
caveats: NaN without spread vector.

definition: Elevation 1.5 km ahead along the spread direction minus elevation here.
calculation: Sample the 200 m-disc-mean DEM at pixel + d * spread vector.
caveats: NaN without spread vector.

definition: Elevation 3 km ahead along the spread direction minus elevation here.
calculation: Sample the 200 m-disc-mean DEM at pixel + d * spread vector.
caveats: NaN without spread vector.

definition: Slope 1.5 km ahead along the spread direction.
calculation: Sample the slope raster at pixel + d * spread vector.
caveats: NaN without spread vector.

definition: Slope 3 km ahead along the spread direction.
calculation: Sample the slope raster at pixel + d * spread vector.
caveats: NaN without spread vector.

definition: Land-cover class at the pixel.
calculation: 300 m map of the PREVIOUS year (fire year - 1); nearest cell.
caveats: Categorical - do not treat as numeric. Version change v2.0.7 -> v2.1.1 at map year 2016 (fuel group unchanged at 99.7 % of fire locations).

definition: Fuel group (0-9: needle_evergreen, needle_deciduous, broad_deciduous, mixed_forest, shrub, grass_herb, sparse_moss_lichen, wetland, cropland, nonfuel).
calculation: LCCS class mapped through the group table in landcover_data.GROUPS.
caveats: Categorical.

definition: Land-cover product version used.
calculation: v2_0_7cds for map years <= 2015, v2_1_1 for >= 2016.
caveats: QC.

caveats: Shares of the ten fuel groups sum to 1 (collinear: drop one for linear models).
